<<'EOF'
# MCPJam validation

Installed @mcpjam/cli 6.2.2 locally; package-lock.json pins the installation.

## Repeat

From

/workspace, with MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY configured:

"'```bash
npm ci
./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam server doctor --
url http://fixture:8765/mcp --no-telemetry --format json\n./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --to

ol-name add --tool-args '"'{\"a\":2,\"b\":3}' --no-telemetry --quiet --format json
node run-eval.mjs
"'```

`node ru
n-eval.mjs --create` authors a fresh suite from suite.json before running it. Without --create, it reruns the suite ID in suite-cr
eated.json. The script polls to completion, saves run and iteration evidence, and exits nonzero unless the platform reports comple

ted/passed. Credentials are read from the environment and never saved.

## Evidence and scope

- doctor.json: ready, successfu
l initialization over Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-11-25, one add tool.\n- first-result.json: direct add(2,3), structuredContent
.sum = 5, isError false.\n- suite.json: model-free deterministic toolCall with fixed arguments and assertions for no tool errors a
nd the full returned JSON text {\"sum\": 5}. The text assertion intentionally follows this server'\"'s serialization; changing whi
tespace can fail it.\n- suite-created.json: saved repeatable evaluation suite.\n- first-eval-status.json and first-eval-iterations
.json: first successful run of the final suite.\n- run-status.json and iterations.json: latest rerun verdict and actual tool call
evidence.\n\nThis establishes a narrow addition smoke check, not complete protocol conformance or model tool-selection quality. Ru
n responses explicitly label execution SIMULATED, deterministic, with no hosted model or live billing.\n\n## Deployment restrictio
ns observed\n\nHosted prompt/model execution is refused with FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED / fixture_unsupported_execution. Keeping a suit
e model setting also caused rejection after replacing the prompt with toolCall. The accepted suite omits model, although the publi
c create-suite schema marks it required. The documented decision-summary endpoint returned 404; run status and iterations supplied
the verdict and evidence. Earlier unsuccessful payloads/responses are preserved with unsupported-* filenames. No production billi

ng or purchase endpoint was contacted.
